citations.quote: Gary McCoy, Michael Nguyen, and Darshini Patel for Supervisor District 8: Any of these candidates would be a good Supervisor, and none of these have been accused of sexual assault like Manny Yekutiel—who has dropped out, but is still on the ballot.

notes: Ranked-choice race: Indivisible SF endorses Gary McCoy, Michael Nguyen and Darshini Patel; the candidate's page lists it as co-endorsed.
